name: Purchase_Request1
_about: Fields added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (02 Procurement / 02 Purchase Request and Pricing, 05 Shared Engines 01, 03, 04). All of them are written by the server (server/modules/procurement/pr-spec.mjs): a widget write to them is dropped.

fields.name: Order_Date
fields.label: Order Date
fields.helpText: The Sales Order date (a PR with no order uses the day it was created), spec DT-1.

fields.name: Pr_State
fields.label: PR State
fields.helpText: One state from the older Open / Converted + Hold_Status + ready flag.

fields.name: Selected_Supplier_Id
fields.label: Selected Supplier ID
fields.helpText: The Suppliers record ID of the selected supplier (the name is only for display, spec INQ-R6).
